## bbbabb45042b

**Reproduced teaching defect — a first-anchor-only rival can fit every demo and
disagree on the query.** The generator correctly validates individual scenes,
but `n_anchors` is independently random rather than lesson-scheduled. At seed
`10`, difficulty `medium`, sample indices `0..3`, the observed anchor counts are
`[1, 1, 1, 3]`. All four inputs pass `self_check` and belong to the documented
generator domain.

The rival preserves the input, selects the same largest red template, but stamps
it only at the first row-major blue anchor. It exactly matches the selected
Racket output on all three demonstrations because each has one anchor, then
differs on the three-anchor query. The complete generated inputs, observed axes,
validator results, intended outputs, rival outputs, source hashes, and comparison
are in `checks/audit/bbbabb45042b/reproducer.json`; supported Racket evidence is
`checks/audit/bbbabb45042b/racket.json`. Generator SHA:
`b9553c8ffed1d7272ba2eb7bc5ff04378200dd5125d205c02f22ae1e7cbfb865`;
executed rule hash: `6f5eebde1e2e`.

Suggested repair: schedule at least one multi-anchor demonstration in every
three-demo/one-query window and every supported query rotation, then declare and
score this rival in `LESSON_COMPETITORS`. The audit target was left unchanged.
